connectionParameters.label: Base URL
connectionParameters.name: base_url
connectionParameters.desc: Cisco Umbrella API base URL (e.g., https://api.umbrella.com)

desc: Cisco Umbrella Cloud Security connector for managing Destination Lists and their destinations (URLs, IPv4 addresses, FQDNs/domains) via the Cisco Umbrella Cloud Security API.

functions.label: Add Destination
functions.name: add_destination
functions.desc: Add one or more destinations (URLs, IPv4 addresses, or FQDNs) to a specified Destination List. Automatically batches requests of more than 500 destinations.

inParameters.label: Destination List ID
inParameters.name: destination_list_id
inParameters.desc: ID of the target Destination List (positive integer)

inParameters.label: Destinations
inParameters.name: destinations
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list or array of destination values (URLs, IPs, or FQDNs)

inParameters.label: Destination Type
inParameters.name: destination_type
inParameters.desc: Type of destination: URL, IPV4, or DOMAIN (auto-detected if omitted)

inParameters.label: Comment
inParameters.name: comment
inParameters.desc: Optional comment or note for the destination entry

functions.label: Get Destinations
functions.name: get_destinations
functions.desc: Retrieve destinations within a specified Destination List with optional pagination.

inParameters.label: Destination List ID
inParameters.name: destination_list_id
inParameters.desc: ID of the Destination List (positive integer)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of destinations and total count

functions.label: Delete Destination
functions.name: delete_destination
functions.desc: Remove one or more destinations from a Destination List by their destination IDs. Maximum 500 IDs per request.

inParameters.label: Destination List ID
inParameters.name: destination_list_id
inParameters.desc: ID of the Destination List (positive integer)

inParameters.label: Destination IDs
inParameters.name: destination_ids
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list or array of destination IDs to delete (positive integers, max 500)

functions.label: Create Destination List
functions.name: create_destination_list
functions.desc: Create a new Destination List in Cisco Umbrella.

inParameters.label: Name
inParameters.name: name
inParameters.desc: Name of the new Destination List

inParameters.label: Is Global
inParameters.name: is_global
inParameters.desc: Whether the list is global (default: false)

functions.label: Update Destination List
functions.name: update_destination_list
functions.desc: Update the name of an existing Destination List.

inParameters.label: Destination List ID
inParameters.name: destination_list_id
inParameters.desc: ID of the Destination List to update (positive integer)

inParameters.label: Name
inParameters.name: name
inParameters.desc: New name for the Destination List
